The '''Vahaba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Vahaba asteroid belt]]. The system was in a well-populated [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] and contained the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Vahaba]] and numerous [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. At some point in the system's past, the largest world in the system disintegrated to form the [[Vahaba asteroid belt]].
